headline: Pakistan cuts petrol prices by Re1 per litre while raising diesel by Rs2
summary: Pakistan's Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority and Ministry of Energy announced revised ex-depot fuel tariffs, cutting petrol by Re1 per litre and raising high-speed diesel by Rs2 per litre.
why: Fuel pricing revisions in Pakistan directly impact transport logistics, inflation baskets, and federal petroleum levy collections.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Diesel increases raise transport and agriculture costs, while petrol price cuts provide minor consumer relief.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
